claims: League of Legends is a 5v5 competitive MOBA.
League of Legends is developed by Riot Games.
League of Legends is for PC and Mac.
League of Legends has over 140 unique champions.
Players destroy the enemy team's base in League of Legends.
Summoner's Rift is the primary map in League of Legends.
Players control a single champion with unique abilities in League of Legends.
Champions gain experience and items throughout a match in League of Legends.
League of Legends is available on PC and macOS.
Champions in League of Legends have roles including fighters, mages, marksmen, and supporters.
Prestige Chibi Valiant Sword Riven is a champion skin in League of Legends.
League of Legends minimum OS requirements are Windows 7/8/10/11 or macOS 10.12+.
LCK, LPL, and LEC are League of Legends leagues.
The 2026 World Championship final is scheduled for the Barclays Center in New York.
